description: Premise gate. Before acting on a plan or approach, surface the load-bearing implicit assumptions it rests on, adversarially refute each (false until proven), and STOP if any load-bearing assumption is false or unverifiable. Use this whenever you are about to act on a plan/approach that depends on a version or feature, an API/CLI shape, a config value, a secret/permission, or "what is currently live" — even when the user never says "assumptions". This is the layer that catches "I assumed X meant Y" before the work, and it complements verification-before-completion, which checks the OUTCOME after the work.
